title: SWSE Phase 0-B — universal vehicle source-entry record (draft v0.5)
description: Universal fixed top-level groups with sparse nested values and nullable verified-absent capabilities; provenance and variants remain separate. Source certification is separate from JSON Schema validation.

identity.description: Publication-entry identity remains distinct from underlying chassis and configuration

sourceEntryKey.description: Unique ID for this particular book/printed statblock entry; do not use ship name alone

vehicleFamilyKey.description: Shared family/design lineage key, nullable until Phase 1 identity reconciliation

variantKey.description: Stable variant key distinct from common family ID

className.description: Class text e.g. frigate or T-65B

variantKind.description: stock, named-ship, modified, alternate-loadout, revision, era, unknown

baseVehicleKey.description: Explicit parent vehicle identity if confirmed; never automatic from name

uniqueNamedVessel.description: True for specific vessel such as Millennium Falcon

publication.description: Source locator, not yet an adjudicated provenance ledger

page.description: Printed sourcebook page, not PDF index

statblockOrdinalOnPage.description: Ordinal when multiple statblocks share printed page

printedTitle.description: Book heading exactly or normalized only for transcription issues

entryNotes.description: Editorial notes, OCR exceptions; not a provenance adjudication

sourceRepresentations.description: Multiple printed statblocks for the same entry, retained without absorbing droid rules into vehicle rules

classification.description: Typed classification and raw classification kept separate

primaryCategory.description: ground-vehicle, airspeeder, starfighter, space-transport, capital-ship, space-station, fixed-emplacement, watercraft, other

chassisType.description: walker, tracked, wheeled, speeder, shuttle, cruiser, freighter, station, etc.

items.description: ground, atmosphere, space, water, underwater, stationary

combatScale.description: Scales in which source supplies operation

items.description: Transport, assault, capital, scout, carrier, medical, etc.

printedSize.description: Complete published size including parenthetical subgroup

size.description: fine, diminutive, tiny, small, medium, large, huge, gargantuan, colossal

colossalSubtype.description: frigate, cruiser, station or other original subtype if given

sizeModifierPrinted.description: Only if explicitly printed or tabulated as source claim

secondaryCategories.description: Other co-published categories, never eliminated through primary-category selection

entityNature.description: Droid, living vessel, conventional vehicle, or other source-supported entity nature; not synonymous with operating category

challenge.description: Published CL is a label, not authority for replacement calculations

cl.description: Published challenge level; do not recalculate to reflect perceived balance

geometry.description: Combat fighting space, size and cover are independent. Enclosure is not derived blindly from cover.

coverCrew.description: none, normal, improved, total, mixed or raw qualifier

coverPassengers.description: Passenger cover; may differ from crew

movement.description: Movement supports any number of modes and both tactical scales

speedModes.description: All published character and starship movement modes

maxVelocityKmh.description: Published universal top speed if statline lists one

sublightDrive.description: Drive type/rating when printed; no invented conversion

minimumSpeed.description: Published forced minimum speed, if any

hoverCapability.description: Confirmed can hover, false only if printed explicitly

specialMovement.description: Movement powers: SLAM, unusual drives, etc.

hyperspace.description: Null only for verified non-hyperdrive/inapplicable craft. Populated object for drive or nav information; sparse object when still under review.

navComputer.description: installed, none, astromech, jump-memory, biological, external, other, unknown

jumpMemoryCount.description: Number of preprogrammed jumps, if printed

astromechRequirement.description: R2, utility droid, optional or mandatory if specified

routeConstraints.description: Known limitation or source specific rule

defenses.description: Exact published defenses, including shield and special defenses

vehicularCombatIncluded.description: Indicates named VC modifier in statblock if present

damageReduction.description: Published DR; null not equivalent to DR 0

shieldRating.description: Published shield rating; positive or zero are numeric values. Null only for verified absence, with /defenses/shieldRating status explicitly-none or not-applicable when certified. Omit during transcription if not yet resolved.

shieldRecharge.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

durability.description: Statblock durability separate from encounter mutable values

hitPoints.description: Published hp baseline; NOT current runtime actor HP

hardness.description: Object rules hardness, if ever explicit; not assumed to equal DR

abilities.description: Vehicle ability scores and stock-crew skill outcomes; do not infer unspecified scores

con.description: Published CON; may be expressly dash

combat.description: Published combat summary; crew-derived figures must not become immutable weapon math

rangedAttackLine.description: Short source Ranged line, including AND/OR choices

items.description: Autofire, Burst Fire or other options

armament.description: Null only when verified unarmed; populated object only if source weapon claims exist; sparse object during unresolved transcription. Weapon mount detail fields are optional until source-established.

weaponMounts.description: Every physical weapon or firing station entry from source

firingGroups.description: AND/OR attack declarations, linked weapons, batteries

attackPatterns.description: Source attack expression alternatives; preserves AND/OR groupings

crew.description: Default printed crew and crew-operated stations, not current actor links

crewQuality.description: untrained, normal, skilled, expert, ace, heroic, custom, other

crewDescriptor.description: Printed modifiers or distribution such as 1 pilot plus two gunners

crewIsOptional.description: Vehicle autonomous or controlled remotely if stated

autonomy.description: crewed, autonomous, remote-controlled, biological-operator, other, unknown

capacity.description: Passengers, cargo, consumables and carried craft; preserve printed units

cargo.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

cargoMetricTons.description: Standardized metric tonnes only when verified conversion; never replace published original

consumables.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

dockingCapacity.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

towCapacity.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

systems.description: Installed starship/vehicle systems, including unusual technology Nullable only on confirmed absence/inapplicability; unverified is a sparse object and must remain uncertified.

installed.description: All nonweapon installed systems from publication

tractorBeams.description: Nonweapon-mode tractor equipment, if source describes it this way

interfaces.description: Astromech sockets, droid brains, computer interfaces

modifications.description: Both emplacement points and other modification slots (not assumed synonyms) Nullable only on confirmed absence/inapplicability; unverified is a sparse object and must remain uncertified.

emplacementPointsRemaining.description: Printed remaining points, not automatically inferred here

templates.description: e.g. junker, advanced or other source-defined templates

notes.description: Source notes; do not infer emplacement points from later-size defaults

economics.description: Separate new vs used and priced vs not-for-sale

priceNew.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

priceUsed.description: Null means confirmed absent; omit if unreviewed.

availability.description: Licensed, Restricted, Military, Illegal, Rare, Unique, etc.

serviceOrMaintenanceCosts.description: If source explicitly gives operating costs

notes.description: Do not fill a new price from commentary on hypothetical market value

text.description: Derived descriptions distinguish player summary from authority

summary.description: Short original player-facing summary, not a copied publication paragraph

mechanicalNotes.description: Brief mechanical overview assembled from certified data

sourceNotes.description: Concise transcriber remarks, not long verbatim source passages

exceptions.description: Catch-all for unusual rules; not a license to quietly skip data

unmappedFacts.description: Every unmapped printed field blocks certification, not discarded

transcriptionWarnings.description: Readability issues in TXT requiring visual PDF review

manualReviewRequired.description: Whether an editor must inspect ambiguous material

fieldStates.description: Sparse JSON-pointer source-status ledger. Only use null to represent verified absence or inapplicability; for a certified record record a corresponding explicitly-none/not-applicable status for each null-valued capability or shieldRating. Omit untranscribed nested properties and record not-stated/unclear-source as needed. Draft records may be incomplete but cannot be source-certified.

rules.description: Separate vehicle-specific rule claims from universal vehicle combat rules.

conditionalMechanics.description: Only vehicle-specific conditional facts, never copies of universal rules.

globalRuleReferences.description: References to independently sourced global rules, not duplicated formulas.

quantity.description: Value/unit pair; preserve source units and do not assume ton equivalences

value.description: Published or normalized numerical value, never inferred without marking derivation

unit.description: Physical unit, e.g. kg, metric-ton, m, days, months, years, credits, squares, km/h

raw.description: Short printed source field, preserving unusual qualifiers

qualifier.description: e.g. approximately, each, external, up to, carried

skill.description: Skill bonus as published on this statblock

attribution.description: vehicle-crew derived, computer, autonomous, or unspecified

rule.description: Exceptional or specialized printed mechanic; no invented effect

category.description: rule family, e.g. special-system, weakness, aura, mobility, attack, action

summary.description: Short original paraphrase only; no full-book rules copied

effect.description: Mechanical effect represented in future typed schema

reference.description: Book page or other publication pointer when established

actionLimitPerTurn.description: Published action use limit if present, never inferred

typedPredicateStatus.description: pending, complete, not-required. A condition string does NOT count as machine-executable

speed.description: One speed mode; multiple modes may coexist

mode.description: walking, tracked, wheeled, repulsorlift, flying, swimming, hovering, burrowing, starship-flight, other

stationKey.description: Stable role key for this statblock

role.description: pilot, copilot, gunner, commander, engineer, system-operator, other

items.description: System or installed weapon mount key

group.description: troops, prisoners, droids, passengers, external riders, etc.

category.description: Ship, walker, speeder, escape pod, unspecified

weaponMount.description: Published armament/statline group on this vehicle; do not equate a battery, attack count and physical mount.

mountKey.description: Unique physical mount key within this vehicle source entry

weaponDefinitionKey.description: Separate canonical weapon authority key; null until identity certified

printedName.description: Source weapon name; always preserve exact model/descriptor

weaponCount.description: Number of individual weapons installed; distinct from batteries/mount count

configuration.description: Single, double, quad, linked, battery, other printed configuration

location.description: Physical location on vehicle, if given

firingArc.description: Front, rear, port, starboard, dorsal, turret, all, other or null

mountType.description: fixed, turret, swivel, external, internal, other or null

fireLinked.description: Weapon fire linking status when established

gunnerStationKey.description: Only a certified actual crew station key; NEVER place generic pilot/gunner text here

gunnerCount.description: Crew needed for weapon/battery as published

attackBonusPrinted.description: Published ATK bonus, not gunner intrinsic bonus

attackBonusAutofirePrinted.description: Autofire alternate attack bonus if shown

damagePrinted.description: Damage dice/special as published; parser must not guess

rangePrinted.description: Ranges or relative range class from source

alternateFireGroupKey.description: Firing mode group used in the Ranged OR/AND attack line

firingCountPrinted.description: Count explicitly in ranged attack declaration, not inferred to physical mounts

operatorRolePrinted.description: Literal pilot/gunner/copilot role; not a resolved crew station identifier

batteryCountPrinted.description: Number of batteries explicitly counted in attack line, not barrels or physical mounts

targetSizeRuleKey.description: A global source rule reference (not an inferred penalty).

label.description: Print-facing attack choice or battery group

operator.description: and, or, battery, single, simultaneous, special

attackBonusPrinted.description: Group printed attack modifier if any

specialNotes.description: OR/AND alternatives, crew coordination, battery attack bonuses

weaponsPerBattery.description: Physical weapons in ONE battery, not number of batteries in source ranged line. Null until established.

supportingGunners.description: Aiding gunners confirmed for this specific attack, NOT inferred from crew size.

category.description: sensors, computer, life-support, propulsion, tractor, shield, stealth, docking, communications, other

quantity.description: Number of installed components if printed

modification.description: Published modification or template on this vehicle

name.description: Published modification, template, upgrade or replacement

price.description: New/used price distinguished from text describing not for sale

status.description: priced, not-for-sale, no-price-stated, estimated, variable, unavailable, ambiguous

operationEffect.description: Canonical structured mechanical effect; consumer mapping occurs in Phase 4

operation.description: add, set, prohibit, reroll, redirect, grant-option, reduce, replace or source-specific pending ontology

target.description: vehicle, attacker, target, gunner, master, shield, incomingAttack, incomingDamage, position

path.description: Semantic canonical path; do not silently treat it as a Foundry system path

value.description: Numeric magnitude, null if not numeric

unit.description: squares, SR, dice, bonus, steps, etc

condition.description: Source condition in source terms, awaiting typed predicate certification

duration.description: Immediate, turn, encounter, etc, only when established

notes.description: One short description of special interpretation

capabilityMode.description: One of a mutually exclusive published operational mode set

capabilityModeGroup.description: Source-defined mutually exclusive modes such as coralskipper dovin basal uses

attackPattern.description: A source-listed allowed attack combination, retaining grouping and alternatives

alternativesGroup.description: Exclusive group for different Ranged/Attack options

craftConfiguration.description: A mutually exclusive published carried-craft capacity choice

exclusiveGroup.description: Only one option within group fits at a time if printed as OR

occupantRole.description: Named occupant e.g. astromech; do not modify pilot/passenger cover globally

coverKind.description: cover, concealment or other printed measure

conditionAst.description: Typed rule predicate; unresolved nodes deliberately fail the certification gate, but remain schema-valid for draft transcription.

oneOf.description: Explicit atomic claim with a defined context vocabulary
Preserve unresolved condition, never evaluate it as true

semanticEffect.description: A typed effect with timing and no implied Foundry consumer

targetPath.description: Semantic authority path, NOT a Foundry system property.

conditionalRule.description: Source condition and effects; schema correctness does not imply executable runtime behavior.
